description:
As per the request of the Principal Swati ma'am, Dr. Darekar has conducted the session in CSV School, DHARAVI, on Wednesday 30thSept. for std. 9th and 10th, for two mediums - Vernacular medium at 10 am and English medium at 1 pm.
Dr. Darekar narrated a simple story to explain the importance of Goal Setting and then by giving some examples he pointed out how to achieve the goal. He gave few tips and formulas and asked to practice the techniques and skills to reach the set Goal.
Overall the sessions were very informative and interesting. Students were interactive and their enthusiasm was remarkable. Principals & Coordinators of both the mediums and teachers of respective classes attended the sessions.
